newsitem.title: USA: One Price sees weaker Q2 EPS, cites sales.
newsitem.headline: One Price sees weaker Q2 EPS, cites sales.

text.p: One Price Clothing Stores Inc, citing a "disappointing" two percent drop in fiscal second-quarter sales, said it expects earnings for the quarter to be $0.05 to $0.07 less than the year ago's $0.28 per share.
The First Call consensus for One Price for the quarter ended August 2 was $0.25.
The company reported second-quarter sales of $86.1 million, down two percent from $87.4 million a year ago. Same-store sales also fell two percent.

"We are disappointed with these sales results. We may have overreacted to the cool spring weather in April and May. We did not aggressively pursue the opportunistic purchases of summer merchandise which could have fueled June and July's business," said Larry Kelley, president and chief executive officer.
The company expects to announce its quarterly earnings during the week ending August 23, 1997.
